description: This file declares external API functions for the Dslh Object Record (Obj Record) component in the DSL Home Model implementation. It contains function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the Obj Record objects, which are exported for use by other modules.

methods.name: DslhCreateObjRecord
methods.description: Creates an instance of the OBJ Record object with given container and owner contexts.

methods.name: DslhObjroCreate
methods.description: Constructs a new Obj Record object with specified contexts.

methods.name: DslhObjroRemove
methods.description: Removes/destroys the specified Obj Record object.

methods.name: DslhObjroEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers necessary sub-objects or components within the Obj Record.

methods.name: DslhObjroInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Obj Record object, setting up internal state.
